policy: A capability, control, certification, customer result, service level, legal right, or deployment property may be stated publicly only when this register marks the exact scoped statement approved and its evidence has not expired. Contract-only and prohibited statements must not appear as general marketing claims.
forbidden_public_phrases: you can self-host the engine and keep sending

claims.statement: Moosewave is completing production-readiness qualification; source presence is not a GA declaration.
The codebase implements revocable sessions, TOTP, role/scope checks, tenant isolation, and CSRF controls; deployment effectiveness is separately qualified.
claims.scope: application implementation only, not an independent assurance claim

claims.statement: The desktop API credential remains in the operating-system vault behind a native origin-bound request broker, and offline records use authenticated encryption.
claims.scope: current desktop release-candidate source and tests

claims.statement: No SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA, auditor, or Big Four certification or engagement may be claimed without scoped independent evidence.
claims.scope: all public, sales, desktop, and client-facing material

claims.statement: Backup frequency, retention, RPO, RTO, failover, restore-drill cadence, and uptime are customer-environment claims only after measured evidence exists.
claims.scope: identified deployed environment and executed order only

claims.statement: Region, transfer mechanism, isolation topology, and subprocessor location are stated only for an identified environment in an executed agreement.
Public legal documents are working drafts and are not represented as counsel-approved or binding unless incorporated into an executed agreement.
claims.scope: privacy, terms, DPA, DPIA, subprocessors, refund, AUP, and affiliate terms

claims.statement: Refund eligibility and timing are controlled by the terms displayed at purchase and the executed agreement, not a standalone marketing promise.
Attributable testimonials, company names, performance metrics, and customer outcomes are prohibited without retained written approval and substantiation.
A route, source file, demo, test, or roadmap entry is not evidence that a capability is shipped or generally available.
claims.scope: public feature status and customer orders

claims.statement: Source availability, self-hosting, escrow, perpetual access, and redistribution rights are not promised until the licensing model and executed customer terms explicitly grant them.
Public indexing and sitemap publication fail closed until an opaque release approval reference is provided at runtime; legal and comparison pages remain unavailable pending their own review.
claims.scope: current web source and one-image runtime publication contract; not evidence of a live approved deployment

claims.statement: Paid checkout is unavailable until the provisional catalog, hard usage caps, provider costs, taxes, refunds, order terms, and a private billing launch approval are reconciled.
claims.scope: public and authenticated web checkout plus API runtime readiness

claims.statement: The public affiliate program, applications, referral tracking, commission terms, and payouts are unavailable until legal and commercial approval plus a separately qualified release contract exist.
claims.scope: public marketing, signup, referral-cookie, public API and embedded-client surfaces

claims.statement: Moosewave's reviewed DNS contract uses moosewave.com and its named subdomains; native store identifiers such as com.moosewave.app and stable extension command identifiers are not DNS claims.
claims.scope: repository-owned active defaults, allowlists, links, contacts and deployment templates; DNS ownership and reachability remain external

claims.statement: Moosewave targets WCAG 2.1 AA and publishes the automated checks it actually runs, the parts that remain unverified, and a barrier-reporting channel. No independent accessibility audit, certification, or assistive-technology user testing is claimed.
